title: Static Overlapping Keeled-Scale Thick-Tail Pangolin
description: One newly authored whole static stylised pangolin-like animal. A narrow gently downturned conical muzzle flows into a small earless head, low arched thick torso and long broad-rooted gradually tapering curved tail as one continuous closed body. Staggered rows of individually thick broad pointed keeled shield scales overlap along the back and tail; they are not quills, transverse armadillo accordion rings or a fur plume. Four short bent limbs end in finite broad soles, with long blunt foreclaw forms at the front feet; small lateral eyes and short dark nose complete the head. All body, tail, limb and shield profiles newly authored with no old animal mesh/coordinate arrays imported. Different entire low long-tailed silhouette from the higher banded armadillo with tall ears and narrow tail or long-legged anteater with huge deep plume tail. One static animal model zero scenes. No exact species/anatomy, scale biology, defensive curling, locomotion, feeding, conservation, specimen handling or safety claim; rig animation interaction not made.
